sloka: अर्थेभ्यो हि विवृद्धेभ्यः संवृत्तेभ्यस्ततस्ततः।क्रियाः सर्वाः प्रवर्तन्ते पर्वतेभ्य इवापगाः ।। ६.८३.३२ ।।
transliteration: arthebhyo hi vivṛddhebhyaḥ saṁvṛttebhyastatastataḥ।kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pravartante parvatebhya ivāpagāḥ ।। 6.83.32 ।।

translations.english: "Prosperity is augmented gradually and developed by all means just as rivers flow from mountains, all undertakings follow conducive to success."
